sources.snippet: Beyond Single Object extends PointLLM-style object-centric 3D-LLMs to relational reasoning over multiple point clouds. The release includes: MO3D: multi-object positional, comparative, and holistic QA. Shape Mating: geometric pair selection with reasoning.
